children: Saia reported LTL shipments per workday up ~1.0% QTD and LTL tonnage per workday up 8.3% quarter-to-date.
July LTL shipments per workday rose 0.8% vs July 2025, showing modest volume growth.
July LTL tonnage per workday increased 7.8% and weight per shipment rose 7.0% vs year-ago.
August LTL shipments per workday rose 1.1%, tonnage per workday up 8.7% and weight per shipment up 7.5% vs August 2025.
Quarter-to-date, LTL shipments per workday +1.0%, tonnage per workday +8.3%, weight per shipment +7.2% vs 2025.

title: Saia posts July-August LTL gains; tonnage per workday +8.3% QTD
